messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partial responses, reconnects). Need owners for remediation items and a cadence for checkpoints. Can everyone drop owners+ETA by EOD? :spiral_calendar: :wave:

alex: I'll own timeout root cause analysis and backlog PRs. ETA end of week for RCA, mid-next-week for fix canary.

tim: I'll take reconnect logic + client SDK retries. Will prototype exponential backoff + jitter, push RFC by Tue.

sarah: I'll handle partial responses — investigating KV cache eviction, token truncation, and possible streaming buffer drops. Need traces and any repros. pinging @eng-obs for traces.

eng-obs-bot: Requested trace bundle: https://internal/trace/abc123 — note: redaction applied.

maya: Great. Also need one person to own dashboards/alerts so we catch recurrence. Who can own SLO+alert tuning?

alex: I can draft the alert spec and initial dashboards, then hand off to platform for long-term ownership.

tim: Platform team — @rachel-platform — can you take alert ownership after initial spec?

rachel-platform: I can. Ask for a short doc with the alert conditions and false-positive tolerances. Let's schedule a 30m sync after PR for the RCA.

maya: Action items summarized (please acknowledge):
- Timeout RCA: alex — RCA by 1924800000 (end of week), fix canary mid-next-week.
- Reconnect backoff RFC + client SDK: tim — RFC by 1924780000, prototype by 1924860000.
- Partial responses root-cause: sarah — traces requested, debug by 1924880000.
- Alerts/dashboard: alex -> handoff to @rachel-platform — alert doc by 1924850000.
- Postmortem follow-up weekly sync: recurring Wed 10am PT — first sync 1924790000.

Please confirm or update.

alex: Confirmed.

tim: Confirmed, will put RFC in #eng-releases for review and include client examples.

sarah: Confirmed, I have traces and a small reproducer that triggers a partial response in ~1 of 200 streams.

rachel-platform: Confirmed, will schedule 30m after alert doc lands and create a short runbook for ops.

maya: I'll create tasks in Jira and tag owners. Also adding recurring calendar invite. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Created Jira tickets: INFR-4821, INFR-4822, INFR-4823, INFR-4824

alex: Quick note for the canary: prefer 10% of streaming nodes with strict timeout logging enabled. Config snippet: 
```
streaming:
  timeout_ms: 12000
  enable_strict_timeout_logging: true
  reconnect_backoff:
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 5000
    jitter: full
```

tim: For the SDK, will add adaptive backoff and client-side drop if server signals protocol error. Example: `retryPolicy: { maxAttempts: 6, backoffBaseMs: 150, jitter: "full" }`

maya: Ok. Let's reconvene Wed 10am PT. If anything blocks — ping me in thread. Closing initial sync. :white_check_mark:
